notes_for_editor: Only two sources, and they agree on the 1934 build and 1975 removal. Neither gives height, builder, staffing or fires. The code M-M is not expanded in either source; the project's designs file has a McClintic-Marshall entry for Pennsylvania steel towers, but no source ties this tower to that maker, so the story does not name one. The regional Pennsylvania listing has a Dry Meadow row with only the county, so it is not cited. No photo was found. The corrections entry proposes kind 'tower' from the register's wording.
